product_one_liner.value: Matillion helps enterprise data teams build, transform, orchestrate and manage cloud data pipelines for analytics and AI, with Maia automating data-engineering work.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports approximately 473 employees as of October 2026.

hq_location.notes: Matillion describes dual headquarters in Manchester, United Kingdom, and Denver, United States; Manchester is shown in the single-location value.

eng_blog.notes: Two engineer-authored build accounts: software engineering interns describe constructing the DPL quality reviewer (2025-08-22) and the architecture and deployment of the internal ObServant monitoring agent (2025-08-20).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Senior Staff AI Engineer.

model_provider.value: Amazon Bedrock; OpenAI; Microsoft Azure OpenAI
model_provider.notes: The product FAQ explicitly names these third-party AI services; pipeline components can use customer-provided accounts and API keys. This is not an exclusive list of supported models.

compliance_certs.notes: HIPAA and GDPR are stated compliance claims, not standalone certifications; HIPAA includes signing an appropriate BAA with applicable customers.

last_funding.notes: Databricks Ventures investment announced November 8, 2022; the amount was undisclosed. The funding database classifies it as Series E - IV. No USD amount is asserted.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is November 2022, before the 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09 window.

launched_6mo.notes: June 1, 2026: public-preview launch of Mission Control and Context Engine, two major Maia capabilities, within 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: August 4, 2026: Girish Pancha appointed CEO and Sanjay Krishnamurthi appointed Chief Development Officer, within the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The data-processing agreement names CRM, marketing and call-recording vendors; the Trust Center explicitly describes Matillion using Salesloft Drift integrated with its Salesforce tenant.
